Ztation- Portable Bluetooth Speaker| Eco-Friendly

Features

Play and Stream Music Wirelessly: Enjoy seamless Ztation- Portable Bluetooth Speaker streaming, allowing you to play your favourite tunes effortlessly.
Wireless Charging: Say goodbye to tangled wires. With Qi wireless charging capability, you can conveniently charge your Qi-enabled devices while enjoying your music.
FM Radio with Autoscan and Presets: Tune in to your favourite radio stations with ease. The FM auto-scan feature ensures you never miss a beat, while the 20 preset stations provide quick access to your preferred channels.
Dual Alarm Clocks and Snooze Function: Wake up on time every day with the dual alarm clocks and snooze function, giving you that extra few minutes of sleep when you need it most.
Versatile Timer and Dimmable LED Display: Keep track of time with the built-in timer and easily adjust the LED display brightness to suit your preferences. Whether you need a gentle glow or complete darkness, the dimmer function has you covered.

Sustainable Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.

Physical Unit

IN THE BOX

  • Boom speaker
  • Type-C or Micro-SB
  • Manual
